import struct

with open('poc_font', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

# Parse the font directory
num_tables = struct.unpack('>H', data[4:6])[0]
print(f'Number of tables: {num_tables}')

for i in range(num_tables):
    entry = data[12 + i*16 : 12 + (i+1)*16]
    tag = entry[0:4].decode('ascii')
    offset = struct.unpack('>I', entry[8:12])[0]
    length = struct.unpack('>I', entry[12:16])[0]
    print(f'  {tag}: offset={offset}, length={length}')
    
    if tag == 'morx':
        morx_data = data[offset:offset+length]
        print(f'    morx version: {struct.unpack(\">H\", morx_data[0:2])[0]}')
        print(f'    morx nChains: {struct.unpack(\">I\", morx_data[4:8])[0]}')
        
        # Parse chain
        chain_start = 8
        default_flags = struct.unpack('>I', morx_data[chain_start:chain_start+4])[0]
        chain_length = struct.unpack('>I', morx_data[chain_start+4:chain_start+8])[0]
        n_feature_entries = struct.unpack('>I', morx_data[chain_start+8:chain_start+12])[0]
        n_subtables = struct.unpack('>I', morx_data[chain_start+12:chain_start+16])[0]
        print(f'    chain: defaultFlags={default_flags}, length={chain_length}, features={n_feature_entries}, subtables={n_subtables}')
        
        # Parse subtable
        sub_start = chain_start + 16 + n_feature_entries * 8
        sub_length = struct.unpack('>I', morx_data[sub_start:sub_start+4])[0]
        coverage = struct.unpack('>I', morx_data[sub_start+4:sub_start+8])[0]
        sub_feature_flags = struct.unpack('>I', morx_data[sub_start+8:sub_start+12])[0]
        print(f'    subtable: length={sub_length}, coverage={coverage}, subFeatureFlags={sub_feature_flags}')
        print(f'    coverage type: {coverage & 0xFF}')
        
        # Parse ContextualSubtable
        cs_start = sub_start + 12
        nClasses = struct.unpack('>I', morx_data[cs_start:cs_start+4])[0]
        class_offset = struct.unpack('>I', morx_data[cs_start+4:cs_start+8])[0]
        state_offset = struct.unpack('>I', morx_data[cs_start+8:cs_start+12])[0]
        entry_offset = struct.unpack('>I', morx_data[cs_start+12:cs_start+16])[0]
        subs_offset = struct.unpack('>I', morx_data[cs_start+16:cs_start+20])[0]
        print(f'    ContextualSubtable: nClasses={nClasses}')
        print(f'      classTable offset: {class_offset}')
        print(f'      stateArrayTable offset: {state_offset}')
        print(f'      entryTable offset: {entry_offset}')
        print(f'      substitutionTables offset: {subs_offset}')
        
        # Check substitutionTables target
        subs_target_start = cs_start + subs_offset
        subs_value = struct.unpack('>I', morx_data[subs_target_start:subs_target_start+4])[0]
        print(f'      substitutionTables[0] = {subs_value} (null: {subs_value == 0})')
"
